template_hint: Fills the fields; everything stays editable.
facts_hint: What happened, in your words. The member reads it.
redress_note: No automated means. The member is told how to appeal (internally within 6 months, out-of-court dispute settlement, court).

measures.publishing_hint: Cannot publish anything or make it public.
measures.suspension_hint: Account suspended. Needs a second team member's approval.

max_days_hint: Moderators suspend for at most :days days.
reason_hint: For the audit log, 10–1,000 characters. The member does not see it.

errors.date_past: The end must be in the future.

spam.label: Spam or advertising
spam.facts_member: You repeatedly sent the same advertising messages to members who do not know you.
spam.facts_vehicle: The vehicle is used to advertise a sale or a business instead of showing a build.
spam.facts_photo: The photo shows advertising or contact details for a sale.

harassment.label: Harassment or insults
harassment.facts_member: You insulted other members in messages and kept writing after being turned down.
harassment.facts_vehicle: The vehicle's description or updates insult other members.
harassment.facts_photo: The photo shows insulting content aimed at others.

impersonation.label: Impersonation
impersonation.facts_member: The account poses as another person or company.
impersonation.facts_vehicle: The vehicle is shown not to be yours; the photos come from others.
impersonation.facts_photo: The photo comes from someone else and is passed off as your own.

nudity.label: Nudity or sexual content
nudity.facts_vehicle: Photos of the vehicle show sexual content.
nudity.facts_photo: The photo shows nudity or sexual content.

illegal.label: Illegal content
illegal.facts_member: Content of your account breaks the law.
illegal.facts_vehicle: The vehicle shows or promotes illegal modifications or content.
illegal.facts_photo: The photo shows illegal content, such as a readable third-party plate tied to a person.
